description: Core script for CKEditor, defining basic editor features, initialization, and dynamic loading of full core code.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.loadFullCore
methods.description: Loads the full CKEditor core script if only the basic code has been loaded.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.appendTo
methods.description: Creates a new editor instance inside a specific DOM element.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.replace
methods.description: Replaces a textarea or DOM element with a CKEditor instance.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all textarea elements in the document with editor instances, optionally filtered by class name or custom function.
